QUOTE: Option C, use the bundled heap: `mbedtls_memory_buffer_alloc_init(buf, len)` (`library/memory_buffer_alloc.c:566`) calls `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free()` with its own `buffer_alloc_calloc` / `buffer_alloc_free`.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the buffer allocator's init function installs its own calloc/free via the runtime setter and that it is the only allocator the library ships. It never says outright that it is the only in-tree caller of the setter, but that is the clear implication.
